dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

The August employment release is an independently measured economic outcome. Trump's subsequent trade threat used the report as context but is a distinct presidential risk statement with no implementing instrument; neither record substitutes for the other.

The September 4 orders direct ranching, competition, processing, wolf and labeling actions. The August 26 proclamation separately implemented a temporary lean-beef import quota increase; the instruments and outcome tests are distinct.

The national measles surveillance outcome concerns a vaccine-preventable infectious disease. The August 31 newborn record measures vitamin K nonreceipt, which is not a vaccine and involves a different intervention, population and outcome.

rejected_candidates.title: Fourteen new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: Posts after the prior snapshot repeated the already-recorded Lake America, G20, employment and Iran themes; promoted a rally and podcast; attacked political opponents; or contained image-only and reposted material. They establish what Trump published, not another independently verified federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: White House tourism and summer-travel claims
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump's post mixed vehicle-mile, park-visitation, international-visitor and sports-event economic-impact figures from different scopes and periods without linking the underlying datasets or methods. The claims were not converted into a policy-specific effectiveness finding.

rejected_candidates.title: Reported review of candidates to replace the Pentagon deputy secretary
rejected_candidates.reason: The consequential personnel report relied on unnamed sources and described a review rather than a nomination, dismissal or appointment. No official action or second independent confirmation was located by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Announced Witkoff and Kushner Ukraine peace mission
rejected_candidates.reason: No completed travel, disclosed proposal, agreement, ceasefire or policy commitment was located by cutoff. It remains a prospective diplomatic lead.

rejected_candidates.title: Cuba health-alert causal overclaims
rejected_candidates.reason: The formal embassy warning and independently reported infrastructure context materially refreshed the existing sanctions record. The alert did not quantify cases, identify pathogens or isolate the effect of the September 3 designations, so those conclusions were withheld.

rejected_candidates.title: Ongoing disputes, campaign activity and duplicate coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: Repeated mail-ballot, Iran, ranching, WOTUS, campaign and personnel coverage added no independently verified lifecycle change after the boundary. Routine rhetoric and plans without an instrument remained outside the canonical layer.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: Unit-specific external measurements remain separate discovery inputs and contribute zero canonical entries by default. No upstream item advanced without original-source inspection and full Record review.

corrections.summary: Restored the September 3 clemency batch after the White House pardon czar publicly announced it September 4 and Reuters independently reported it after the prior cutoff. The record preserves the action's actual date and explicitly states that the complete roster, pardon-versus-commutation breakdown and warrants were not public by cutoff.
